validator: EndQuote independent GLB binary/geometry acceptance checker v1
limitations: This focused checker is not the complete Khronos glTF conformance validator.
Cushion names/counts and footprint checks do not prove visual classification; inspect the Blender previews.
A valid scene hierarchy does not prove absence of geometric intersections or floating components.
Browser rendering performance and device-dependent shading require target-app QA.

checks: GLB 2 header/chunk/buffer/accessor ranges
self-contained payload under 2 MB
no cameras, lights, skins, or animations
finite accessor values
named opaque metallic-roughness PBR materials
one named identity root and applied rotations/scales
valid hierarchy and material references
decoded finite positions and unit normals
valid triangle indices and nondegenerate faces
meter-scale bounds, Y-up, floor contact and centered origin
unit orthogonal tangents with valid handedness and normal-map UV references
descriptive cushion nodes and specified category seat counts
no disconnected export hierarchy or unreferenced scene nodes
warnings: Embedded textures are present; browser texture memory is not measured here.
